existing_group_assignments.rationale: Increased PPAR-alpha activation concerns the same PPARalpha object as the group's activation and decreased-activation events, in the opposite direction to the decreased-activation member.
Activation of the ionotropic GABA receptor chloride channel shares the same object as the inhibition and decreased-conductance events but is a distinct process.
Decreased E2 at the hypothalamus is the same decrease in estradiol as the plasma and granulosa-synthesis events, in a different compartment.
Decreased ovarian E2 is the same decrease in estradiol, in an ovarian context.
Aromatase enzyme inhibition during a specific estrous-cycle window is the same inhibition process as the general event, with added context.
Hyperplasia of ovarian stromal cells is the same process in a specific cell type.
Hyperplasia of ovarian epithelium is the same process in a specific tissue.
Smooth muscle hypertrophy/hyperplasia includes hyperplasia in a specific tissue context.
Cellular proliferation/hyperplasia of acinar cells is the cell-type-specific form of the general proliferation/hyperplasia event.
Increased proliferation of mesenchymal cells is increased cell proliferation in a specific cell type.
Ovarian adenomas are an adenoma/carcinoma event in a specific tissue.
Pancreatic acinar tumors are an adenoma/carcinoma event in a specific tissue.

new_groups.rationale: Inhibition of different deiodinase isoforms (DIO2 vs DIO1) is the same process on different enzymes.
Reduced swim bladder inflation, posterior versus anterior chamber.
Induction of paralysis in somatic muscle versus pharyngeal muscle.
Both describe decreased GnRH release, with different specifics (kisspeptin stimulation vs pulsatility in the hypothalamus).
